config.name: Connections to or from DROP-listed networks per minute, allowed and denied
config.sqlTemplate:
WITH ['42.128.0.0/12', '42.160.0.0/12', '42.208.0.0/12', '147.16.0.0/14', '196.16.0.0/14', '101.134.0.0/15', '112.142.0.0/15', '168.80.0.0/15'] AS drop_list
SELECT $__timeInterval(t) AS ts,
       verdict,
       count() * 60 / $__interval_s AS "connections/min"
FROM (SELECT t, firewall, verdict, if(arrayExists(n -> isIPAddressInRange(src, n), drop_list), src, dst) AS address
      FROM (
        SELECT _timestamp_load AS t, 'Cisco ASA' AS firewall, if(event_outcome = 'failure' AND event_action != 'logon-failed', 'denied', 'allowed') AS verdict, replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(assumeNotNull(source_ip)), '::ffff:', '') AS src, replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(assumeNotNull(destination_ip)), '::ffff:', '') AS dst
        FROM dfe.`cisco-asa`
        WHERE $__timeFilter(_timestamp_load)
        UNION ALL
        SELECT _timestamp_load AS t, 'FortiGate' AS firewall, if(event_action = 'deny', 'denied', 'allowed') AS verdict, replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(assumeNotNull(source_ip)), '::ffff:', '') AS src, replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(assumeNotNull(destination_ip)), '::ffff:', '') AS dst
        FROM dfe.fortinet
        WHERE $__timeFilter(_timestamp_load)
      )
      WHERE arrayExists(n -> isIPAddressInRange(src, n) OR isIPAddressInRange(dst, n), drop_list))
GROUP BY ts, verdict
ORDER BY ts

config.name: DROP-listed connections the firewalls allowed
config.sqlTemplate:
WITH ['42.128.0.0/12', '42.160.0.0/12', '42.208.0.0/12', '147.16.0.0/14', '196.16.0.0/14', '101.134.0.0/15', '112.142.0.0/15', '168.80.0.0/15'] AS drop_list

config.name: Top DROP-listed networks
config.sqlTemplate:
WITH ['42.128.0.0/12', '42.160.0.0/12', '42.208.0.0/12', '147.16.0.0/14', '196.16.0.0/14', '101.134.0.0/15', '112.142.0.0/15', '168.80.0.0/15'] AS drop_list
SELECT arrayFirst(n -> isIPAddressInRange(address, n), drop_list) AS "Network",
       countIf(verdict = 'allowed') AS "Allowed",
       countIf(verdict = 'denied') AS "Denied",
       uniqExact(address) AS "Addresses"
FROM (SELECT t, firewall, verdict, if(arrayExists(n -> isIPAddressInRange(src, n), drop_list), src, dst) AS address
      FROM (
        SELECT _timestamp_load AS t, 'Cisco ASA' AS firewall, if(event_outcome = 'failure' AND event_action != 'logon-failed', 'denied', 'allowed') AS verdict, replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(assumeNotNull(source_ip)), '::ffff:', '') AS src, replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(assumeNotNull(destination_ip)), '::ffff:', '') AS dst
        FROM dfe.`cisco-asa`
        WHERE $__timeFilter(_timestamp_load)
        UNION ALL
        SELECT _timestamp_load AS t, 'FortiGate' AS firewall, if(event_action = 'deny', 'denied', 'allowed') AS verdict, replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(assumeNotNull(source_ip)), '::ffff:', '') AS src, replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(assumeNotNull(destination_ip)), '::ffff:', '') AS dst
        FROM dfe.fortinet
        WHERE $__timeFilter(_timestamp_load)
      )
      WHERE arrayExists(n -> isIPAddressInRange(src, n) OR isIPAddressInRange(dst, n), drop_list))
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC, 3 DESC
LIMIT 10

config.name: DROP-listed addresses seen
config.sqlTemplate:
WITH ['42.128.0.0/12', '42.160.0.0/12', '42.208.0.0/12', '147.16.0.0/14', '196.16.0.0/14', '101.134.0.0/15', '112.142.0.0/15', '168.80.0.0/15'] AS drop_list
SELECT address AS "Address",
       firewall AS "Firewall",
       countIf(verdict = 'allowed') AS "Allowed",
       countIf(verdict = 'denied') AS "Denied"
FROM (SELECT t, firewall, verdict, if(arrayExists(n -> isIPAddressInRange(src, n), drop_list), src, dst) AS address
      FROM (
        SELECT _timestamp_load AS t, 'Cisco ASA' AS firewall, if(event_outcome = 'failure' AND event_action != 'logon-failed', 'denied', 'allowed') AS verdict, replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(assumeNotNull(source_ip)), '::ffff:', '') AS src, replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(assumeNotNull(destination_ip)), '::ffff:', '') AS dst
        FROM dfe.`cisco-asa`
        WHERE $__timeFilter(_timestamp_load)
        UNION ALL
        SELECT _timestamp_load AS t, 'FortiGate' AS firewall, if(event_action = 'deny', 'denied', 'allowed') AS verdict, replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(assumeNotNull(source_ip)), '::ffff:', '') AS src, replaceOne(IPv6NumToString(assumeNotNull(destination_ip)), '::ffff:', '') AS dst
        FROM dfe.fortinet
        WHERE $__timeFilter(_timestamp_load)
      )
      WHERE arrayExists(n -> isIPAddressInRange(src, n) OR isIPAddressInRange(dst, n), drop_list))
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 3 DESC, 4 DESC
LIMIT 16
